description: The same waterlogged threat from the original combat prototype, now data-driven instead of hardcoded.

moves.name: Claw
moves.description: Claws at whatever's closest.

description: A rat the size of a housecat, grown fat on whatever the flood left behind.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: A quick, opportunistic bite.

moves.name: Scurry
moves.description: Darts out of easy reach.

description: It doesn't so much attack as attach.

moves.name: Latch
moves.description: Fastens onto the nearest warm thing.

moves.name: Drain
moves.description: A slow, patient draw of blood.

description: Something that used to be someone's dog, before the water got into everything.

moves.name: Snap
moves.description: A fast, snapping bite.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: A growl that promises the next bite will be worse.

description: Slow, heavy, and strong enough to knock you flat if it connects.

moves.name: Croak Slam
moves.description: Its whole bulk, thrown forward.

moves.name: Puff Up
moves.description: Swells to twice its size.

description: A dim light that shouldn't be able to survive underwater, and shouldn't want to follow you.

moves.name: Clinging Damp
moves.description: A cold that settles in and doesn't leave.

moves.name: Flicker
moves.description: Dims to almost nothing.

description: A drowned tourist, fused at the throat and wrists with high-voltage neon wiring and fiber-optic cable. It still remembers being lost, and it still wants company.

moves.name: Strangling Cable
moves.description: A fiber-optic line lashes out of the dark, humming with current.

moves.name: Cracked-Tube Hum
moves.description: A buzzing warning, coiling tighter before it strikes.

stages.transition_text: The last working bulb shatters. The room goes fully dark, and something wraps tighter around your throat.

moves.name: Blackout Choke
moves.description: No more patience left for circling in the dark.

moves.name: Surge Through the Cable
moves.description: The wiring flares white-hot along its whole length.

moves.name: Final Wire Whip
moves.description: Nothing left to lose, and nothing left to see it coming.

moves.name: Coil and Choke
moves.description: It wraps a second cable around before you can cut the first.

stages.transition_text: Every working bulb on it flares at once and dies. What's left doesn't need light to find your throat anymore.

moves.name: Raw Nerve Lash
moves.description: Nothing left to conserve.

moves.name: Feedback Loop
moves.description: The cable bites and keeps biting.

moves.name: Last Current
moves.description: Everything it has left, through your chest.

description: A weeping silhouette perched atop a sunken taxi depot. She was a mother once. The flood remembered that before it remembered anything else.

moves.name: Hurled Container
moves.description: A shipping container arcs out of the dark water toward you.

moves.name: Weeping Silence
moves.description: She goes still, and the water holds its breath with her.

stages.transition_text: Her weeping sharpens into an ultrasonic wail that scrambles everything you thought you knew about this fight.

moves.name: Container Barrage
moves.description: The current itself seems to aim this one.

moves.name: Ultrasonic Wail
moves.description: A scream pitched to unravel you slowly.

moves.name: Grieving Hush
moves.description: What cracks, she regrows.

stages.transition_text: Her limbs stretch impossibly long, sliding beneath the water toward your feet. Whatever's still floating is the only safe ground left.

moves.name: Reaching Limbs
moves.description: Everything she has left, in one motion.

moves.name: Chokehold From Below
moves.description: She doesn't need to see you to find your throat.

moves.name: Last Embrace
moves.description: One final hardening, more instinct than strategy now.

moves.name: Undertow Grasp
moves.description: She's not letting either of you leave this one.

description: A mutated stray that never left the stall it used to guard. It still remembers its post, and it still thinks you're trespassing.

moves.name: Guard Bite
moves.description: A fast, territorial snap.

moves.name: Territorial Snarl
moves.description: This stall has an owner, and it isn't you.

description: A collapsed market stall's tarp, still billowing like it's got customers to flag down. Nobody's buying anymore.

moves.name: Tarp Snare
moves.description: Wraps around whatever's closest.

moves.name: Haunted Billow
moves.description: A cold, mildewed gust that clings.

description: Small, fast, and delighted by how much it can steal before you notice.

moves.name: Snatch
moves.description: A quick grab at whatever's loose.

moves.name: Vanish
moves.description: Gone before the counter-swing lands.

description: Something that used to sing for tourists outside a pet stall. It hasn't stopped, but the song isn't music anymore.

moves.name: Discordant Shriek
moves.description: A pitch that settles under the skin and stays.

moves.name: Panicked Peck
moves.description: Frantic, without much behind it.

description: A clay guardian from Section 7, animated by whatever's still pulsing in the amulets stacked around it.

moves.name: Clay Fist
moves.description: Slow, heavy, and hard to take twice.

moves.name: Amulet Pulse
moves.description: The talismans around it flare, and the clay hardens.

description: Four-armed, fused at the shoulders to a rack of cages holding mutated fighting fish. It still haggles - you just can't understand the price anymore.

moves.name: Caustic Spit
moves.description: One of the caged fish, aimed at you.

moves.name: Cage Rattle
moves.description: The whole rack shakes - a warning, not an attack.

stages.transition_text: The cages crack. What's inside starts spitting on its own, wherever it wants.

moves.name: Twin Cage Spit
moves.description: Two cages at once, no more haggling.

moves.name: Bile Frenzy
moves.description: Caustic spray that keeps burning after it lands.

moves.name: Desperate Weighing
moves.description: It tips its own scale, betting everything on the next strike.

display_name: The Chimera of the Drowned Aviary
description: Hundreds of mutated birds from the market's exotic-pet stalls, moving as one shifting avian titan.

moves.name: Wing Battering
moves.description: A hundred wingbeats landing as one.

moves.name: Feathered Ward
moves.description: The flock tightens into a shield.

stages.transition_text: The titan shudders and scatters into a hundred smaller strikes at once - there's no single wingbeat left to predict.

moves.name: Scattering Strikes
moves.description: It isn't one attack anymore. It's all of them.

moves.name: Panicked Shrieking
moves.description: A hundred throats, none of them happy about this.

moves.name: Regroup
moves.description: The flock pulls back into formation.

stages.transition_text: The flock collapses inward into one emaciated vulture-beast. Something blind and weeping is curled in its open chest cavity, still counting its old profits.

moves.name: Vulture Dive
moves.description: Everything left, thrown at once.

moves.name: The Boss's Final Count
moves.description: It doesn't need to see you to know the tally's about to close.

moves.name: Last Roost
moves.description: One final huddle, more instinct than strategy now.

description: Bigger than anything native to this canal should be, with an oily sheen that isn't just water.

moves.name: Death Roll
moves.description: Drags whatever it's bitten under.

moves.name: Submerge
moves.description: Vanishes beneath the slick.

description: Grown fat on runoff nobody wanted to trace back to its source.

moves.name: Electric Lash
moves.description: A jolt that shouldn't be biologically possible down here.

moves.name: Caustic Bite
moves.description: The wound keeps burning long after the bite lets go.

description: Still wearing a hi-vis vest, faded past reading. Still swinging a cargo hook nobody's paying him to swing.

moves.name: Cargo Hook Swing
moves.description: Decades of muscle memory, aimed at you now.

moves.name: Rusted Grip
moves.description: Tightens a grip that never really let go of the job.

description: Fused to a corroded loading frame that's more of it now than the man ever was.

moves.name: Scrap Slam
moves.description: The whole rusted frame, thrown forward.

moves.name: Rust Plating
moves.description: What's left of the frame locks into place.

description: A sheen on the water that moves against the current, toward you specifically.

moves.name: Caustic Sheen
moves.description: Coats whatever it touches in something that keeps eating.

moves.name: Slick Dodge
moves.description: Spreads too thin to hit cleanly.

description: A harbor worker grafted to hydraulic forklift blades that never got the shutdown signal.

moves.name: Hydraulic Cleave
moves.description: The blades don't need him to aim them anymore.

moves.name: Blade Whir
moves.description: Spins up defensively between strikes.

stages.transition_text: Something in the hydraulics redlines. The blades don't slow down anymore.

moves.name: Overclocked Cleave
moves.description: Faster than the frame was ever rated for.

moves.name: Rending Frenzy
moves.description: A wound that keeps opening under its own momentum.

moves.name: Pressure Surge
moves.description: The hydraulics build toward something worse.

description: An amorphous mass of oil, hair, and sewage that erupted through the floor grates and never went back down.

moves.name: Grate Eruption
moves.description: More of her than should fit through a floor grate, all at once.

moves.name: Amorphous Recoil
moves.description: Absorbs the hit by simply not having a fixed shape.

stages.display_name: The Scum Matron (Rising Through the Grates)
stages.transition_text: More of her pushes up through the floor grates than the canal should ever have been able to hold.

moves.name: Sewage Surge
moves.description: A wave of everything the canal never let go of.

moves.name: Caustic Bloom
moves.description: Something in her keeps burning after it lands.

moves.name: Hair-Choked Guard
moves.description: A tangled mass thick enough to stop a blade in it.

stages.transition_text: She hardens into an oily carapace right as it catches - the whole canal surface ignites around her.

moves.name: Burning Carapace Slam
moves.description: Everything she's hardened into, on fire, thrown at you.

moves.name: Ignition Wave
moves.description: The burning oil doesn't care how much of you is already gone.

moves.name: Molten Shell
moves.description: One last hardening, glowing at the seams.

description: What's left of a harbor tug, animated by nothing anyone wants to name. It doesn't hunt so much as insist you come with it.

moves.name: Undertow Grab
moves.description: A rope of black water hauls at your ankles.

moves.name: Backwash Slam
moves.description: The full weight of the current, all at once.

moves.name: Brace Against the Flow
moves.description: It digs in and holds.

description: Bred fast and hungry in water thick with leaked transformer current. It doesn't need to bite to hurt you.

moves.name: Live Wire Coil
moves.description: It wraps close and just... conducts.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.description: A single, ugly pulse.

moves.name: Recoil Guard
moves.description: It curls away from its own current.
